id: 16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co
title: 实验室安全：压缩气体与低温液体
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co/src.py

points.K3: 非液化气体：始终是气体
points.K4: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
points.K7: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
points.K8: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
points.K9: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
points.K10: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
points.K11: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
points.K12: 减压阀和压力表要配套
points.K13: 认识之后，才谈安全使用

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在几只不同形状的气瓶和一个低温罐旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside several gas cylinders of different shapes and a cryogenic container, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识压缩气体和气瓶。
overlay: 实验室安全：压缩气体与低温液体

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰站在气瓶库里，看看细高瓶又看看矮胖瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a cylinder storeroom looks from a tall narrow cylinder to a short fat one.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇：气瓶怎么有高有矮？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李走过来，拍拍一只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and pats the shoulder of a cylinder.
shots.narration: 老李说：先从里面装的气讲起。

shots.section_title: 压缩气体分三类
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现三个图标：液滴、气体云、溶在液体里的气泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a liquid drop, a gas cloud, and gas bubbles dissolved in a liquid.
shots.narration: 压缩气体分三类。

shots.section_title: 液化气体：瓶里是液体
shots.scene: 戴手套的手拧蓝色液化气瓶阀门；气瓶剖面下半是液体
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the valve of a blue liquefied gas cylinder; a cutaway shows liquid in the lower half. No people.
shots.narration: 液化气体在加压气瓶里会变成液体。

shots.section_title: 液化气体：瓶里是液体
shots.scene: 一个元素方块图标，旁边一排锈迹斑斑的红蓝气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A glowing chemical element tile icon beside a row of rusty red and blue cylinders with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 如氯气、二氧化碳、液化石油气、

shots.section_title: 液化气体：瓶里是液体
shots.scene: 一只液化气瓶图标挂空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A single liquefied gas cylinder icon with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一氧化二氮。

shots.section_title: 非液化气体：始终是气体
shots.scene: 气瓶剖面里只有气体小点，旁边温度计上下变化
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway cylinder filled only with gas dots, a thermometer icon rising and falling beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 非液化气体，不论温度都保持气态。
overlay: 非液化气体：始终是气体

shots.section_title: 非液化气体：始终是气体
shots.scene: 分子模型动画，旁边四只气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotating molecule model animation beside four tall cylinder icons with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 也叫压缩气体，有氮、氧、二氧化碳、氦。

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 这类气体图标晃动不稳
shots.prompt_en: A wobbling, unstable gas cloud icon with shaking lines. No people.
shots.narration: 溶解气体很不稳定，
overlay: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 气泡溶进液体后安静下来
shots.prompt_en: Gas bubbles settle calmly once dissolved into a liquid solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 要溶在液态溶剂里才能稳定。

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 一排红色乙炔瓶，瓶身有易燃气体菱形标志
shots.prompt_en: A row of red acetylene cylinders with flammable gas diamond pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是乙炔，

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶剖面：多孔填料浸透丙酮，爆炸图标被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the cylinder packed with porous filler soaked in acetone; an explosion icon is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里塞满浸透丙酮的填料，防止爆炸。

shots.section_title: 气瓶必须标识清楚
shots.scene: 戴蓝手套的手拿着有毒品菱形标志
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a blue glove holds up a toxic diamond pictogram label.
shots.narration: 各类气体危害不同，

shots.section_title: 气瓶必须标识清楚
shots.scene: 小研把标签贴到气瓶肩部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label with a hazard pictogram onto a cylinder shoulder.
shots.narration: 所以气瓶一定要标识清楚。

shots.section_title: 气瓶分三种结构
shots.scene: 各色气瓶合成图，带各类菱形危险标志
shots.prompt_en: A composite of many colored cylinders carrying various diamond hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 按内容物种类和压力，气瓶设计不同。

shots.section_title: 气瓶分三种结构
shots.scene: 货车上成排气瓶，工厂卧式储罐，三种容器图标
shots.prompt_en: Rows of cylinders on a truck, a horizontal tank in a plant, and three container icons. No people.
shots.narration: 主要有高压、低压和低温容器三种。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 成排蓝色高压气瓶，剖面显示厚壁
shots.prompt_en: A row of tall blue high-pressure cylinders, one shown in cutaway with a very thick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 高压气瓶通常细高、壁厚，
overlay: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 阿杰想拎起空气瓶，吃力皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to lift an empty tall cylinder and grimaces at its weight.
shots.narration: 空瓶也很重，多为钢或铝制。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 压力表图标指向高位
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with the needle far on the high side beside a tall cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 最高能承受10000磅每平方英寸。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 一排高压气瓶挂空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A row of tall cylinders with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 常装氮、氦、氢、氧和二氧化碳。

shots.section_title: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
shots.scene: 沙滩上一只矮胖的液化气罐，剖面显示薄壁焊缝
shots.prompt_en: A short fat gas tank on a beach, with a cutaway showing a thin wall and a welded seam. No people.
shots.narration: 低压气瓶矮胖、较轻，壁薄有焊缝。
overlay: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝

shots.section_title: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
shots.scene: 压力表指针在中低位，旁边两只低压瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with the needle at a lower position beside two short fat cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 最高承压500，装液化石油气和制冷剂。

shots.section_title: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
shots.scene: 户外大型白色低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: A large white outdoor cryogenic storage tank. No people.
shots.narration: 低温容器工作压力在20到500之间。
overlay: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压

shots.section_title: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
shots.scene: 温度计上升，管道上的安全阀放出气体
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rising while a relief valve on a pipe releases a puff of vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 温度升高时，用泄压阀释放压力。

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 老李用链条把气瓶固定在墙装支架上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens a chain around an upright cylinder on a wall-mounted bracket.
shots.narration: 不论哪种气瓶，都必须有支撑。
overlay: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 墙装支架、链条、地面锚固三个图标，旁边一排白色气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a wall bracket, a chain and a floor anchor, beside a row of white cylinders standing on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 可以用墙装支架、链条或锚固装置。

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 空瓶和满瓶都被同一个支架稳稳撑住
shots.prompt_en: An empty cylinder and a full cylinder both held firmly in the same rack. No people.
shots.narration: 锚固要撑得住空瓶，也撑得住满瓶。

shots.section_title: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
shots.scene: 戴安全帽的老李在管道车间用对讲机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat talks on a radio in a pipe workshop.
shots.narration: 易燃、有毒气体的所有管路系统，
overlay: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规

shots.section_title: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
shots.scene: 三本空白标准书，封面有星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank standard books with small stars-and-stripes flag icons on their covers. No people.
shots.narration: 都要符合美国三家机构的标准。

shots.section_title: 减压阀和压力表要配套
shots.scene: 戴红色焊工手套的手在气瓶上装减压表
shots.prompt_en: Hands in red welding gloves mount a pressure regulator with gauges onto a cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 减压阀和压力表要按气瓶类型选配，
overlay: 减压阀和压力表要配套

shots.section_title: 减压阀和压力表要配套
shots.scene: 减压阀被拿去接另一种气瓶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a regulator being moved onto a different kind of cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能改作他用。

shots.section_title: 认识之后，才谈安全使用
shots.scene: 墙边支架上的绿色气瓶，欣欣站在旁边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside green cylinders in a wall rack.
shots.narration: 压缩气体性质活泼，
overlay: 认识之后，才谈安全使用

shots.section_title: 认识之后，才谈安全使用
shots.scene: 气瓶周围浮现多个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Several warning triangles float around a gas cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 使用中会有许多危害，还要继续学。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三种气体图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating icons: a liquid drop, a gas cloud and dissolved bubbles.
shots.narration: 液化、非液化、溶解，三类气体。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 高压瓶、低压瓶、低温容器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tall cylinder, a short fat cylinder and a cryogenic container. No people.
shots.narration: 高压、低压、低温，三种容器。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 带标签、链条固定、配套减压阀的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A labeled cylinder chained to a rack with a matching regulator, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标识清楚、固定支撑、阀表配套。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在气瓶架旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a gas cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 认清气瓶，安全用气，下次见！
